subject: geography
title: Uneven Development & Global Commons
welcome_lead: Quantify global inequality and shared resources.
meta_desc: A-Level Geography adventure on uneven development, global commons and Antarctic Treaty.

concepts.def: Inequality measure (0 = perfect equality, 1 = max inequality).
Human Development Index combining income, education, life expectancy (0-1).
Areas beyond national jurisdiction: high seas, atmosphere, Antarctica, outer space.
1959, peaceful scientific use; mineral extraction banned; 56 parties.
More/Less Economically Developed; binary terms increasingly replaced by Global North/South.
Shared resources over-exploited when no one owns them (Hardin, 1968).

walkthroughs.body_html: Norway HDI 0.961 (1st); Niger 0.394 (last). GDP per capita ratio: USA $80000 vs Burundi $260, a 300x gap. Oxfam (2023): richest 1 percent took two-thirds of new wealth created since 2020.

Antarctic Treaty (1959) prohibits military use and mineral extraction. UNCLOS (1982) covers ocean floor; deep-sea mining negotiations ongoing. Atmosphere governed via UNFCCC since 1992 with limited enforcement.

Antarctica covers 14 million km^2 (1.5x Europe). Madrid Protocol (1991) extends Antarctic Treaty: mining ban until 2048 review. Tourism reached 105000 visitors in 2022/23 season, raising environmental concerns.
